dct_description_sm: The goal of this research is to provide an in-depth understanding of the relationship between permafrost thaw induced environmental changes and changes in the net ecosystem carbon balance (NECB) of palsa peatlands. Empirical field research and modelling approaches are being used to investigate the factors that control the magnitude and rate of carbon balance changes, and how each carbon flux responds to thawing in a permafrost peatland. We are adapting the McGill Wetland Model to be able to simulate the carbon dynamics of permafrost peatlands.
dct_title_s: NEE, CH4 and DOC exchanges across a thawing peatland palsa landscape
